We have to win!''"<br />"''Hmm&hellip; I get the feeling ''Master Anakin'' might have recommended a more ''direct'' form of acquisition.''"<br />"''Yeah, well, I thought it might be ''fun'' to try a mission that ''didn't'' result in all out war for a change!|Kit Fisto and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] went on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Callos]] to prevent the ''[[Venomator]]'', a highly advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designed by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Bogg]], from falling into the wrong hands.
